'''''Corporate''-class modular units''' were pre-fabricated pods designed by [[Loronar Corporation/Legends|Loronar Corporation]] to be used in constructing facilities for [[Megacorporation/Legends|megacorporations]]. Each unit was self-contained, and most contained their own supply of emergency gear and supplies since they were intended to be used in harsh environments. They could be carried by [[medium freighter]]s and were very easy to connect to each other to form a variety of structures. Units could be used for living quarters, research, storage, or command centers.<ref name="H&S" />
